verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a Muted item status, which supports the mute/ignore part of the story, and its grouping and merging of occurrences into items helps reduce duplicate noise. Nothing in the pack covers spike protection or per-key rate limits; the ability to disable an abused client token is an adjacent control, not rate limiting. Missing for 10: spike protection, per-access-token rate limits, configurable notification throttling or mute rules, independent corroboration.
